$comment: The units of this language: which teaching points, in which order, with which worksheet types. Everything else in a unit is filled by scripts/units/assemble.js. status 'pilot' = noindex, in no sitemap, linked from nowhere. A lesson's screen activity must not run ahead of the teaching (an activity with subtraction before the subtraction lesson): name it per lesson ("activity") or set it to null to use a page of the lesson that checks the answers.
